crop.notes: Whole 'Bobbie Burns' Birthday' item, headline to end of guest list.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that a Mr. Tom Allen was among the guests at the Order of Scottish Clans ball held at Masonic hall on January 25, 1883, in memory of Robert Burns.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Friday Morning, January 26, 1883', page 6. Missouri Republican until 1888.

notes: Only a name in a guest list ('Mr. Tom Allen'); nothing identifies him as the boxer (who was English, not Scottish). Human should decide whether to keep. No facts recorded.
